question: 坦克指挥官的坦克命令有什么效果？
answer:
根据档案，**坦克指挥官**（罗格多恩坦克指挥官、黎曼鲁斯坦克指挥官）本身并不提供"坦克专属命令"——它们使用的是星界军通用的**指挥之声**命令表。以下按档案逐条说明。

---

## 一、指挥之声的通用机制

来源：[《星界军10版中文》第1页]

- 拥有本技能的**军官模型**可在以下时刻下达命令：
  - 你的**指挥阶段**中
  - （本模型所在单位）**脱离运输工具**的阶段结束时
  - （本模型所在单位）**部署到战场**的阶段结束时
- 选择一条命令，对其 **6寸内**一个友军单位生效，持续到**下个你的指挥阶段开始时**。
- 除非特殊说明，**一个单位只能被一条命令影响**（后生效的立即替换之前的）；接令单位若处于**被震慑状态**，影响它的命令效果**立即失效**。
- 命令效果**只对星界军模型生效**。

---

## 二、命令效果表

来源：[《星界军10版中文》第1页]

| 命令名称 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| **快快快！** | 本单位模型 **M+3** |
| **上刺刀！** | 本单位模型近战武器 **WS+1** |
| **瞄准！** | 本单位模型射击武器 **BS+1** |
| **一排放！二排放！** | 本单位模型**【速射】武器 A+1** |
| **卧倒！** | 本单位模型 **SV 值提高1，最多3+** |
| **职责与荣誉！** | 本单位模型 **LD 和 OC 值提高1** |

---

## 三、两位坦克指挥官的命令差异

| 项目 | 罗格多恩坦克指挥官 | 黎曼鲁斯坦克指挥官 |
|---|---|---|
| 命令数量 | 最多 **2 条** | 最多 **2 条** |
| 命令范围 | **12寸**（通讯网络） | **12寸**（通讯网络） |
| 可命令对象 | 编队单位 | 中队单位（可下达命令给中队单位） |
| 来源 | [《星界军10版中文》第33页] | [《星界军10版中文》第31页] |

> 注：档案中罗格多恩坦克指挥官的关键词含**编队**，黎曼鲁斯坦克指挥官的关键词含**中队**，且其兵牌明确写有"可以下达命令给中队单位"。

---

## 四、11版补充：超重型坦克的指挥能力

来源：[《Faction Pack Astra Militarum》第5页]

- **STEEL HAMMER**：在**Muster Armies**步骤，你可从军队中选择一个或多个星界军 **Titanic** 单位获得 **Character** 关键词。设计者注：这意味着被选单位可获得**强化**，且其中之一可被选为**统帅**。
- **强化 BATTALION COMMANDER**（仅限星界军 Titanic Character 模型）：持有者获得 **Voice of Command** 技能与 **Officer** 关键词，并可向星界军 **Titanic 与 Squadron** 单位下达最多 **2 条命令**。

---

**结论**：坦克指挥官下达的就是上表六条通用命令，本身没有独立的"坦克命令"条目。若问的是**超重型坦克**的指挥强化，则见档案6的 **BATTALION COMMANDER**。

档案缺失部分：档案未给出"编队"与"中队"关键词的具体定义，建议查阅原始规则书。

## STEEL HAMMER（续）
### KEYWORDS
In the Muster Armies step, you can 
select one or more Astra Militarum 
Titanic units from your army to gain the 
Character keyword.
**Designer’s Note**: This means that the 
selected units can be given Enhancements, 
and one of them can be selected as 
your Warlord.

### ENHANCEMENTS
#### BATTALION COMMANDER
High‑ranking officers of armoured regiments may 
operate super‑heavy tanks as command vehicles, their 
orders blaring from hull‑mounted laud hailers or 
crackling over internal vox‑channels.
Astra Militarum Titanic Character model only. The 
bearer has the Voice of Command ability and the 
Officer keyword, and can issue up to 2 Orders to 
Astra Militarum Titanic and Squadron units.

#### TITAN KILLER
Seeking to add another kill marking to their war 
machine, this glory‑hungry tank commander seeks out 
and engages only the heaviest enemy assets.
Astra Militarum Titanic Character model only. Each 
time the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can re‑roll 
the Damage roll.

#### ENGINE SPEAKER
Intimately attuned to the machine spirits of Astra 
Militarum vehicles, this Tech‑Priest administers rites 
and rituals, seeking to draw additional performance 
from engines.
Astra Militarum Tech‑Priest Enginseer model only. 
Each time the bearer uses its Omnissiah’s Blessing 
ability, until the start of your next Command phase, 
add 3" to the Move characteristic of the selected 
Vehicle model.

#### ASSAULT HATCHES
Ramps and hatches slam down on all sides of this 
titanic vehicle, enabling infantry to surge forth and 
overwhelm the enemy.
Astra Militarum Titanic Character Transport model 
only. Each time a unit disembarks from the bearer 
after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still 
eligible to declare a charge this turn.

## COMMAND RE-ROLL 15.02 (1CP)
**CORE STRATAGEM**
*A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.*
**WHEN**: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:
▪ Advance roll
▪ Charge roll
▪ Damage roll
▪ Hazard roll
▪ Hit roll
▪ Save roll
▪ Wound roll
▪ A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.
**TARGET**: That unit or model.
**EFFECT**: You re‑roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re‑roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

## OBJECTIVES (14)（续）
### SECURED OBJECTIVES (14.03)
Some rules allow an objective to be secured by a player’s army. When an objective is secured by a player’s army, that objective remains under their control – even once they no longer have any units within range of it – until their opponent’s level of control over that objective is greater than theirs at the end of a phase.

> **HOLD AT ALL COSTS**
> Some units have abilities that are triggered when they control an objective, or when they secure an objective for your army.
**SEE ALSO**  
Objectives Not Within a Terrain Area

**CONTROLLING A TERRAIN OBJECTIVE**

*++ FOR A WARRIOR THE ONLY CRIME IS COWARDICE ++*

This unit is currently battle-shocked, so the OC characteristic of all of its models is ‘-’.  
The models in this unit each have an OC characteristic of 1. Six of its models are within the terrain area.  
This VEHICLE has an OC characteristic of 3, and it is within the terrain area.

answer:
# 铁幕答复

## 一、泰坦军团（Adeptus Titanicus）单位数量

根据档案，**无法给出确切总数**。

档案中明确列出的泰坦修会点数值仅有 **4 个**：

| 单位 | 模型 | 点数 |
|------|------|------|
| 掠夺者级泰坦 | 1 模型 | **2200 点** |
| 战争使者型天罚级泰坦 | 1 模型 | **2600 点** |
| 战犬级泰坦 | 1 模型 | **1100 点** |
| 战将级泰坦 | 1 模型 | **3500 点** |

[《6月4日分数中文》第5页]

此外，档案 5 提供了**战将泰坦**的完整兵牌数据（M10" / T16 / SV2+ / W100 / LD6 / OC30）[《黑图书馆》第0页]。

**注意**：档案 2 与档案 4 均提及 "the Adeptus Titanicus datasheets in this document"，即泰坦修会兵牌收录于该 Faction Pack 文档中，但**档案未给出该文档的完整兵牌清单**。因此除上述 4 个点数条目与 1 张战将泰坦兵牌外，其余兵牌数量**档案缺失，建议查阅原始规则书**。

---

## 二、混沌战将泰坦是否另有独立兵牌与点数？

**否。** 按档案 2 的规则，混沌泰坦军团**不另设独立兵牌，也不另设独立点数**。

具体机制为：

- **兵牌复用**：直接使用本文件中的 Adeptus Titanicus 兵牌来代表 Titanicus Traitoris 模型 [《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]。
- **关键词替换**：在这些兵牌及 Army Rules 卡上，将所有 **Imperium** 关键词替换为 **Chaos**，将所有 **Adeptus Titanicus** 阵营关键词替换为 **Titanicus Traitoris** [《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]。
- **点数沿用**：点数数值**使用与对应 Adeptus Titanicus 模型相同的已发布点数**（"use those published for the equivalent Adeptus Titanicus models"）[《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]。

因此，混沌战将泰坦在规则上等同于**战将泰坦兵牌 + 关键词替换**，点数仍为 **3500 点**，并非另有一张独立兵牌或另一套点数。

---

## 三、补充：设计师注记

档案 2 附有 Designer's Note，指出泰坦是足以扭转战局的庞然战争机器，部分模型点数**超过 Onslaught 规模战斗所能容纳的上限**，其设计面向"你能想象的最末日级规模"的战场 [《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]。

---

**结论**：档案仅支持"4 个点数条目 + 1 张战将泰坦兵牌"的陈述，完整兵牌总数档案缺失；混沌战将泰坦**无独立兵牌、无独立点数**，以关键词替换方式复用忠诚派兵牌与点数。

### FORMING ATTACHED UNITS 19.01
Some units have the Leader or Support ability listed on their datasheet (see below). Such units are known as leader units and support units respectively. Rules that are triggered when a unit is destroyed are only triggered when the last model that started the battle in an attached unit is destroyed.

---

## 一、指挥之声的通用机制

[《星界军10版中文》第1页]

- 拥有该技能的**军官模型**可在以下时刻下达命令：
  - 你的**指挥阶段**中
  - （本模型所在单位）**脱离运输工具**的阶段结束时
  - （本模型所在单位）**部署到战场**的阶段结束时
- 选择一条命令，对其 **6寸内**一个友军单位生效，持续到**下个你的指挥阶段开始时**。
- 除非特殊说明，**一个单位只能被一条命令影响**（后生效的立即替换之前的）；接令单位若处于**被震慑**状态，影响它的命令效果**立即失效**。
- 命令效果**只对星界军模型生效**。

## 二、可选命令及效果

| 命令名称 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| **快快快！** | 本单位模型 **M+3** |
| **上刺刀！** | 本单位模型近战武器 **WS+1** |
| **瞄准！** | 本单位模型射击武器 **BS+1** |
| **一排放！二排放！** | 本单位模型【速射】武器 **A+1** |
| **卧倒！** | 本单位模型 **SV 值提高1，最多3+** |
| **职责与荣誉！** | 本单位模型 **LD 和 OC 值提高1** |

## 三、两位坦克指挥官的差异

| 项目 | 罗格多恩坦克指挥官 | 黎曼鲁斯坦克指挥官 |
|---|---|---|
| 下达命令数量 | 最多 **2 条** | 最多 **2 条** |
| 命令范围 | **12寸**（通讯网络） | **12寸**（通讯网络） |
| 可命令对象 | 编队单位 | 中队单位（可下达命令给中队单位） |
| 来源 | [《星界军10版中文》第33页] | [《星界军10版中文》第31页] |

> 注：档案中罗格多恩坦克指挥官的关键词含**编队**，黎曼鲁斯坦克指挥官的关键词含**中队**，且后者明确写有"可以下达命令给中队单位"。

## 四、11版补充：超重型坦克的指挥能力

[《Faction Pack Astra Militarum》第5页]

- **BATTALION COMMANDER**（强化，仅限星界军**泰坦级人物**模型）：持有者获得**指挥之声**技能与**军官**关键词，并可向星界军**泰坦级和中队**单位下达最多 **2 条命令**。

---

**结论**：坦克指挥官下达的就是上表六条通用命令，本身没有独立的"坦克命令表"；其特殊性在于**命令数量（2条）**与**范围（12寸）**，以及可命令的单位类型（编队/中队）。档案未涉及其他坦克专属命令，如需进一步确认建议查阅原始规则书。

## 一、泰坦军团（Adeptus Titanicus）单位数量

---

## 二、混沌战将泰坦是否另有独立兵牌与点数？

**否。** 按档案文本，混沌泰坦军团（Titanicus Traitoris）**不另设独立兵牌，也不另设独立点数**。

具体机制为 [《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]：

- 可直接使用本文件中的 **Adeptus Titanicus 兵牌数据**来代表 Titanicus Traitoris 模型；
- 转换方式为：在这些兵牌及本军团规则卡上，**将所有 `Imperium` 关键词替换为 `Chaos`**，并将所有 `Adeptus Titanicus` 阵营关键词替换为 `Titanicus Traitoris`；
- 点数方面，**使用与对应 Adeptus Titanicus 模型相同的已发布点数**（"use those published for the equivalent Adeptus Titanicus models"）。

因此，**混沌战将泰坦并非一张新兵牌**，而是以战将泰坦兵牌为基底、经关键词替换后使用，点数沿用战将泰坦的 **3500 点** [《6月4日分数中文》第5页；《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]。

---

## 三、补充：泰坦军团的编成规则要点

档案另载两条与编成相关的规则 [《Faction Pack Adeptus Titanicus》第2页]：

- **Towering Example**：若你的 Army Faction 为 Adeptus Titanicus，在集结军队时**忽略 Select Detachment Rules 步骤**；在 Select Warlord 步骤中，从军中选一个 Adeptus Titanicus 模型作为统帅，**即使该模型没有 Character 关键词**。你的军队获得 **Take and Hold** 武力倾向。
- **Titanic Support**：若你军中**每个模型**都带 `Imperium` 关键词，你可以在军中**加入 1 个 Adeptus Titanicus 模型**，即使它不具备你在 Select Army Faction 步骤中所选的阵营关键词。

> 关于上述两条规则在 Titanicus Traitoris 下的关键词替换后如何具体适用，档案未进一步展开，**档案缺失，建议查阅原始规则书**。

---

**结论摘要**：
1. 泰坦修会点数索引列 **4 个**单位。
2. 混沌战将泰坦**无独立兵牌、无独立点数**，以战将泰坦兵牌经关键词替换使用，点数 **3500 点**。

## ADEPTUS TITANICUS ARMY RULES

Titans are amongst the largest war engines to be found anywhere in the galaxy, ponderous battleships of the land whose weapon batteries are capable of obliterating entire formations of enemy troops. Created before the dawn of the Imperium, each god-engine is a miracle of forgotten technology. During the catastrophic wars of the Horus Heresy, the once-mighty Titan Legions warred against one another in great numbers, but their numbers are now much diminished. Some units have the Leader or Support ability listed on their datasheet (see below). Such units are known as leader units and support units respectively. Both of these abilities allow such units to lead other friendly units (known as bodyguard units) to form attached units. An attached unit is a single unit for all rules purposes. Leader and support units can only lead specific bodyguard units, as listed in the Warhammer 40,000 app.

**LEADER 24.22 / SUPPORT 24.34**: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.

Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

### ATTACKING ATTACHED UNITS 19.02
Each time an attack targets an attached unit, if that unit contains one or more bodyguard models, use the highest T characteristic of the bodyguard models in that unit while resolving that attack, even if a leader/support unit in that attached unit has a different T characteristic. If that unit only contains leader/support models, use the highest T characteristic of those models while resolving that attack instead.

Rules that are triggered when a unit is destroyed are only triggered when the last model that started the battle in an attached unit is destroyed.

The heroes of your army rarely fight alone. Instead, they typically lead bands of warriors, forming an attached unit that acts as a single entity. This section explains how to form attached units and how they function on the battlefield.

## STRATEGIC RESERVES
### PLACING UNITS IN STRATEGIC RESERVES 20.01

Before the battle, in the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one or more friendly units (excluding FORTIFICATIONS) to place in strategic reserves. Instead of setting up these units on the battlefield during deployment, place them to one side; they are strategic reserves units, and will arrive later in the battle.

Unless otherwise stated, the combined points value of all of your strategic reserves units (including those embarked within TRANSPORTS that are themselves placed in strategic reserves) cannot exceed 50% of your points limit for your battle size.
